messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. RIVERSIDE - DAY

The air is thick with the scent of damp earth and ozone. A GLASSY EYE opens wide in the murky depths. The water shimmers with a strange, dimmed light. Suddenly, a rough HAND plunges into the current. Fingers close around a SILVER SCALES body. The FISH gasps for air that is too thick to breathe. It thrashes against the dry, wooden dock. A HUMAN holds it up, tilting its head back. The sky above is a ring of fire, a perfect black hole swallowing the sun. The fish stares into the void.
